typography.minimum_font_size: 12px (never use 10px/11px for labels or table headers to guarantee WCAG AA readability)

component_styles.civr_card: background: #141414; border: 1px solid #262626; border-radius: 14px; padding: 1.25rem (20px) on mobile, 1.5rem (24px) on desktop; transition: border-color .2s ease, background-color .2s ease, transform .2s ease;

civr_btn.base: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 42px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; transition: all .15s ease; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
civr_btn.danger: background: transparent; color: #fb7185; border: 1px solid rgba(251, 113, 133, 0.4);

component_styles.civr_input: background: #0f0f0f; border: 1px solid #262626; color: #f3f4f6; border-radius: 10px; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; width: 100%; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease;
component_styles.civr_label: font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #34d399; margin-bottom: 6px;
component_styles.civr_pill: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
component_styles.civr_table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px. Header: font-size: 12px, font-family: 'DM Sans', color: #a1a1aa, uppercase, padding: 12px. Rows: border-bottom: 1px solid #262626, padding: 12px, hover bg: #181818.
component_styles.tabs_strip: flex wrap, gap-2, padding-bottom: 4px, border-bottom: 1px solid #262626. Active tab: border-bottom 2px solid #34d399, text #34d399, font-weight 600.
component_styles.sidebar_nav: padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #a1a1aa; active bg: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.1) text: #34d399.
component_styles.topbar: height: 64px; background: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid #262626; z-index: 40;
component_styles.mobile_bottom_nav: fixed bottom 0, left 0, right 0; height: 64px; background: #121212; border-top: 1px solid #262626; grid-cols-5; text-size: 11px; labels flex-wrap & truncated appropriately for French/Spanish ('Portefeuille', 'Billetera', 'Numéros').

spacing_and_layout.i18n_text_expansion: French and Spanish strings are 20-40% longer. Ensure buttons, nav tabs, table cells, and mobile navigation items use flexible layouts, max-w with truncation where necessary, and flex-wrap so text never overflows or overlaps.

landing_page_polish.hero_headline: font-display text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black, line-height 1.05, text-transform uppercase to keep French/Spanish titles punchy and balanced without breaking lines awkwardness.
landing_page_polish.pricing_cards: civr-l-card with 1px border rgba(254, 253, 245, 0.12), padding 2rem, highlighted emerald badge for recommended tier.

motion_and_microinteractions.hover_transitions: transition: background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease

general_ui_ux_guidelines.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components (buttons, links, inputs, tabs, switches, modals, menu items) and key info containers MUST have descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="numbers-tab-forwarding", data-testid="wallet-topup-btn").
general_ui_ux_guidelines.contrast_wcag_aa: Ensure contrast ratio exceeds 4.5:1 for standard text and 3:1 for large text/interactive borders against dark surfaces (#0a0a0a and #141414).
general_ui_ux_guidelines.no_transparent_overlays: Never use fully transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, or fixed sticky headers. Always apply backdrop-blur with semi-opaque background e.g. bg-[#0a0a0a]/90 backdrop-blur-md.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply all CSS updates to /app/frontend/src/cloudivr/cloudivr.css including grey token mapping, minimum 12px font size, and revised civr-* classes.
Update /app/frontend/src/cloudivr/ui.js and related components to replace hardcoded muted greys (#888, #8a8a8a, #9a9a9a, #aaa) with semantic classes or high-contrast tokens (#a1a1aa, #d4d4d8).
Ensure mobile bottom navigation in Shell/MobileNav gracefully handles Spanish and French translation lengths with proper flex/text truncation/wrapping.
Verify all interactive elements retain or gain appropriate data-testid attributes.
